# Miniature city — Style Prompt

> A busy place seen from high above through a tilted lens and a time-lapse camera: only a thin horizontal band is sharp, the colours look like model paint, and the whole world moves in quick, jittery steps like wind-up toys.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A place from a high oblique vantage through a **tilt-shift lens**: one strip of the frame is razor sharp and everything above and below melts into blur, so the eye reads a macro shot of something small. Two more things sell the trick: **saturated, sunny colour** (freshly painted model railway) and **time-lapse** (vehicles and people hop in steps; a clock with a speed readout keeps the audience honest).

Not a toy or clay render (the world is a real place, only lens and clock make it small), not a game's top-down view (no UI, no flat clean shading), not drone footage (the band, the saturation and the stutter are mandatory).

**Footage and stand-ins.** The look is footage-based. The example paints a stand-in miniature (a harbour apron) in 2D so it works anywhere; when the user has real high-angle footage of a place, the assistant takes it from `list_media` and puts the same band, colour grade, clock and signs over it instead of the painted shots.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **World**: oblique boxes (roof displaced up-left, front and left walls visible), windows in 21 px bays with a few sky-reflective panes, roof clutter, hard sun shadows falling right and down (a blue-black wash, never grey), trees as shaded spheres, small candy-coloured vehicles and capsule people. Paint it once and only move it.
- **Blur band**: three copies of the same picture, sharp / medium blur (about 6 px at 1× zoom) / strong blur (about 16 px). The sharp copy shows through a fixed vertical gradient mask centred on screen (clear from 41% to 59% of the height, fading out by 20% and 78%); the medium copy covers 24%–74% with soft edges; the strong copy sits under everything. The mask never moves, the camera only slides the pictures under it. Narrowing the band for intimacy is a transform on the masked layers (scale the layer, counter-scale its content), not a repaint.
- **Grade**: saturation high, soft contrast, warm highlights, blue shadows, a light vignette. Moving things stay sharp copies of their own blur level (draw them separately per level).
- **Ground-painted type**: titles lie on the ground, flattened to about 62% height like everything else on the plane, in a dark ink on a pale pavement; they blur with the world.
- **Road-sign panels** for subtitles and numbers: dark panel, bright border, a tiny traffic-light glyph on the left, sitting inside the lower blur zone.

## 3. Colour logic

- **`--latar`** is the shadow navy: HUD and sign panels, shadows (via the fixed `--bayang`). **`--utama`** is the model-paint hero colour: the one saturated thing in the sharp band (the hero vehicle), roofs of the main building, the underline on ground titles. **`--aksen`** tints water and glass. Paint everything else from `--utama`/`--aksen` mixed toward white or black.
- **Fixed** (extra tokens, never replaced by a brand): asphalt `--aspal`, concrete `--beton`, skin, wood crate, and the candy set `--cat-merah/-hijau/-biru/-kuning` for boats, awnings, vans and traffic-light lamps.
- Words on a panel use `--teks`; the key line uses `--utama-di-latar`; borders and the speed readout use `--aksen-di-latar`. Ground titles use the fixed `--aspal` on pale concrete so they read under any brand.
- Night and dawn are the only low-saturation states.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: Oswald 700 for ground titles (about 124 px at 1920 wide, tracking 0.07em) and big numbers (118 px); signage-style, condensed.
- `--font-isi`: Inter 600, 38–42 px, inside the sign panels; second lines 36 px in the key colour.
- Clock and readout: IBM Plex Mono 600, 46 px clock and 19 px `×60 TIME-LAPSE` label in the top-left corner; the label becomes `×1 WAKTU NYATA` at real speed.
- Keep one or two short lines per panel (panels hold at least max(1.8 s, reading time + 0.6 s)).

## 5. Motion quality

- **Time-lapse stutter is the soul.** While speed is above ×2 the whole world (vehicles, people, boats, the clock) is sampled at 8 Hz (each position held for 3 frames at 24 fps) and the camera stays smooth on every frame. Below about ×2 the stutter disappears and motion turns silky, so a drop to real time lands hard.
- **Speeds**: ×60 for the opening wide (4 s), ×30 while following a subject (4 s), ×120 for the number beat (4 s), then a 0.9 s ramp down to ×1. The clock counts world seconds; the label steps down with the ramp.
- Camera moves are slow eased slides with a gentle push-in (zoom +14% per shot, power2.inOut; about 250–800 world px per beat). Cuts land on shot boundaries every ~4 s; no dissolves that reveal the fake lens.
- Hero actions at real time get art-directed timing: a short squash, a 0.7 s arc, a squash and a settle (`back.out(2)`), then stillness for the last two seconds.
- Counters tick in steps (`steps(26)` over 2.9 s), never smoothly.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| High oblique wide, slow slide at ×60 | a whole system at a glance | opening a place, a routine, a crowd |
| Zoom in, band follows one subject | "this one" | a courier, a delivery, one performer |
| Slow push-in, wide, number counting | scale, accumulation | totals, a day's output, a crowd forming |
| Rack the band between two spots | attention changing hands | cause and effect, comparison |
| Cut to close, band narrowed, speed drops to ×1 | the one small thing that matters | a hand-over, a decision, a reunion |
| Lateral track along a line (road, rail, river) | a process in order | supply chain, parade, race |

## 7. Native moves

- **The speed drop (×120 to ×1).** Time crashes to real speed on one detail. *Fits content like:* a fishmonger receiving the first crate of the day; a teacher handing out the first exam; a barista pouring the first cup of a festival.
- **The band as pointer.** The sharp strip follows one subject across the wide. *Fits content like:* a delivery truck through a market; a runner through a race; a parcel through a warehouse.
- **God's-eye system.** The place as a machine, many tiny actors. *Fits content like:* a port unloading; a school's sports day seen from the roof; a food-court at lunch.
- **Counting sign.** A road-sign panel counts up while the clock races. *Fits content like:* orders packed before opening; kilometres of a charity ride; visitors at a fair.
- **Ground title.** The name lies flat on the plaza. *Fits content like:* a market's name; a festival; a channel's series title.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Tall buildings plus shallow pitch hide the ground: keep buildings low to mid-rise in the sharp band.
- The hero hides in a canyon: route it on the camera side and let the band follow it.
- A smooth world kills the look: stutter the world, never the camera. Do not step the camera.
- Blur on the real subject: keep the subject at the band's centre line; check it at every shot.
- Do not animate `filter: blur()`; use the three fixed layers. Do not mix the band into a full-frame canvas redrawn per frame.
- Text that sits on the ground is blurred by the lower layers: put important lines in sign panels, not only on the ground.
- Saturation without blue shadows reads as game CG; grey shadows kill the model look.

# Miniature city: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.4, long 4.4.

## hook

- en: high oblique wide of the whole place at x60, sharp band on the busiest strip, world stepping at 8 Hz, a road-sign line, clock running
- id: pandangan miring tinggi seluruh tempat ×60, pita tajam di jalur tersibuk, dunia melompat 8 kali per detik, rambu teks, jam berjalan

## problem

- en: zoom in and slide: the band follows one subject across the wide while the rest of the world blurs and streams past it
- id: mendekat dan menggeser: pita tajam mengikuti satu tokoh melintasi layar, sisanya buram dan mengalir lewat

## fact

- en: locked frame at the band: one detail sits sharp while the world around it steps; a road-sign line names it
- id: bingkai terkunci di pita: satu detail tajam sementara dunia sekitarnya melompat; rambu teks menamainya

## step

- en: lateral track along a line (road, rail, quay), the band holding the current stage; each stage gets one sign and a clock tick
- id: kamera menyusur satu garis (jalan, rel, dermaga), pita menahan tahap yang sedang jalan; tiap tahap satu rambu dan satu detak jam

## compare

- en: rack the band between two spots in one wide; the speed readout changes between them (x120 vs x1)
- id: pita digeser antara dua tempat dalam satu pandangan lebar; angka kecepatan berubah di antaranya (×120 lawan ×1)

## number

- en: slow push at x120, a big sign counts up in time-lapse steps while the clock races
- id: naik pelan di ×120, papan besar menghitung naik melompat-lompat sementara jam berlari

## proof

- en: the world slows to real time on one proof: a close actor, band narrowing, smooth movement
- id: dunia melambat ke waktu nyata pada satu bukti: tokoh dekat, pita menyempit, gerak mulus

## offer

- en: push in on the place's door or counter, band narrowing, a sign carries the offer in the signage style
- id: mendekat ke pintu atau meja tempat itu, pita menyempit, rambu membawa tawarannya bergaya papan jalan

## cta

- en: speed drops to x1 and the camera stays low: one small hand-over happens in real time, then the frame rests with a sign and contact
- id: kecepatan jatuh ke ×1, kamera mendekat: satu serah terima kecil berlangsung waktu nyata, lalu diam dengan rambu dan kontak

## payoff

- en: the band widens until the model reads as a real place, or lights go out one by one; hold still for the last two seconds
- id: pita melebar sampai maket tampak seperti tempat nyata, atau lampu padam satu per satu; diam dua detik terakhir

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Kota miniatur</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Oswald"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Oswald"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #1b2a52; --latar-2: #2c4378; --utama: #f2b53f; --aksen: #2aa58c;
        --teks: #f6f1e3; --teks-redup: #aebbd6; --teks-di-utama: #1b2a52; --teks-di-aksen: #08231e;
        --utama-di-latar: #f5c35a; --aksen-di-latar: #4fd1b1;
        --font-judul: "Oswald", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Cat maket dan beton dermaga: tetap di semua brand. */
        --aspal: #28344f; --kota: #5f7298; --beton: #cfd5df; --bayang: #16204a; --kulit: #f0c9a4; --peti: #d89b4f;
        --cat-merah: #e4573b; --cat-hijau: #63b936; --cat-biru: #2f72d6; --cat-kuning: #f4c542;
      }
      * {margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html, body {width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);}
      #root {position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);color:var(--teks);font-family:var(--font-isi);}
      img, canvas {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:block;}
      /* Tiga lapis blur: tajam (pita), agak buram (cincin), sangat buram (dasar). Maskenya tetap, kamera hanya menggeser isi. */
      .lv, .un {position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%;}
      #lv0 {-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 20%, black 41%, black 59%, transparent 78%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 20%, black 41%, black 59%, transparent 78%);}
      #lv1 {-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 3%, black 24%, black 74%, transparent 95%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 3%, black 24%, black 74%, transparent 95%);}
      .cam {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:2900px;height:1600px;transform-origin:0 0;will-change:transform;}
      /* Judul ditulis di tanah dermaga, dipipihkan seperti bidang miring. */
      #ttl {display:none;}
      .ttl {position:absolute;left:340px;top:336px;width:1100px;transform:scaleY(0.62);transform-origin:0 0;color:var(--aspal);}
      .ttl b {display:block;font:700 124px/1.0 var(--font-judul);letter-spacing:0.07em;}
      .ttl i {display:block;height:12px;margin:6px 0 10px;background:var(--utama);}
            /* Tokoh utama jarak dekat: sedikit lebih besar dari aslinya supaya terbaca. */
      #hero {visibility:hidden;}
      .w {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:15px;height:30px;border-radius:8px 8px 5px 5px;transform-origin:50% 100%;}
      .w::before {content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:-11px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kulit);}
      #wa {background:var(--cat-biru);} #wb {background:var(--cat-merah);}
      #cr {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:24px;height:17px;background:var(--peti);border:2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--peti) 55%, black);}
      .vig {position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 75% at 50% 50%, transparent 55%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 55%, transparent));}
      /* Jam dan pembaca kecepatan time-lapse. */
      #hud {position:absolute;left:48px;top:40px;padding:10px 20px 12px;border:3px solid var(--aksen-di-latar);border-radius:10px;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 88%, transparent);font-family:"IBM Plex Mono", monospace;font-weight:600;}
      #clk {display:block;font-size:46px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--teks);letter-spacing:0.04em;}
      #spd {display:block;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:var(--aksen-di-latar);}
      .scene {position:absolute;inset:0;}
      /* Papan teks bergaya rambu: lampu lalu lintas kecil di kiri. */
      .sign {position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:78px;margin:0 auto;width:fit-content;max-width:1500px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;padding:16px 36px 18px 22px;border:4px solid var(--aksen-di-latar);border-radius:12px;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 92%, transparent);color:var(--teks);font:600 42px/1.2 var(--font-isi);white-space:nowrap;visibility:hidden;}
      .sign::before {content:"";flex:none;width:30px;height:66px;border-radius:9px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, var(--cat-merah) 7px, transparent 8px), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--cat-kuning) 7px, transparent 8px), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 82%, var(--cat-hijau) 7px, transparent 8px), var(--latar-2);}
      .sign span {display:block;} .sign span + span {color:var(--utama-di-latar);font-size:36px;}
      .stat b {font:700 118px/1 var(--font-judul);color:var(--utama-di-latar);min-width:190px;text-align:right;}
      .stat p {font:600 38px/1.25 var(--font-isi);}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Dunia: tiga salinan peta yang sama dengan tingkat blur berbeda. Isinya dirakit skrip. -->
      <div class="lv" id="lv2"><div class="cam" id="cam2"></div></div>
      <div class="lv" id="lv1"><div class="un"><div class="cam" id="cam1"></div></div></div>
      <div class="lv" id="lv0"><div class="un"><div class="cam" id="cam0">
        <div id="hero"><div class="w" id="wa"></div><div class="w" id="wb"></div><div id="cr"></div></div>
      </div></div></div>
      <div class="ttl" id="ttl"><b>TELUK LAMUN</b><i></i></div>
      <div class="vig"></div>
      <div id="hud"><b id="clk">05:40:00</b><small id="spd">×60 TIME-LAPSE</small></div>
      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: dermaga dari ketinggian, pita tajam di jalur truk, dunia bergerak patah-patah. -->
      <div class="scene" data-role="hook"><div class="sign" id="s1"><span>05.40, dermaga Teluk Lamun sudah bergerak.</span></div></div>
      <!-- Adegan 2, masalah: pita tajam mengikuti satu truk es yang harus sandar lebih dulu. -->
      <div class="scene" data-role="problem"><div class="sign" id="s2"><div><span>Satu truk es harus sandar paling dulu.</span><span>Tanpa es, ikan tak laku dilelang.</span></div></div></div>
      <!-- Adegan 3, angka: dunia dipercepat ×120, hitungan melompat. -->
      <div class="scene" data-role="number"><div class="sign stat" id="s3"><b id="n">0</b><p>peti es turun ke dermaga<br />sebelum lelang dibuka</p></div></div>
      <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: waktu jatuh ke ×1, satu peti diserahkan, lalu diam. -->
      <div class="scene" data-role="cta"><div class="sign" id="s4"><div><span>Lelang ikan buka 06.00. Datang pagi.</span><span>Chat 0812-3456-7890</span></div></div></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl=gsap.timeline({paused:true});
      const $=(id)=>document.getElementById(id),mk=(t)=>document.createElement(t);
      const {floor,abs}=Math;
      const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>(v<a?a:v>b?b:v),lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,ss=(u)=>u*u*(3-2*u);
      // PRNG berbiji: dunia sama di pratinjau dan render.
      const RNG=(seed)=>{let s=(seed*2654435761)>>>0||1;return()=>{s=(s+0x6d2b79f5)>>>0;let t=s;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t ^= t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};};
      const W=2900,H=1600,SH=0.35;
      const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),T=(n)=>cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      const M=(a,b,p)=>`color-mix(in oklab, ${a} ${p}%, ${b})`;
      const C={
        latar:T("--latar"),utama:T("--utama"),aksen:T("--aksen"),aspal:T("--aspal"),beton:T("--beton"),
        kota:T("--kota"),kulit:T("--kulit"),peti:T("--peti"),merah:T("--cat-merah"),hijau:T("--cat-hijau"),biru:T("--cat-biru"),kuning:T("--cat-kuning"),
      };
      const CANDY=[C.merah,C.hijau,C.biru,C.kuning,C.utama];
      const WARM=[C.kuning,C.utama,C.merah,C.peti,C.kuning,C.utama];
      const SHD=M(T("--bayang"),"transparent",42);
      const layer=(w,h)=>Object.assign(mk("canvas"),{width:w,height:h});

      // ===== 1. Kotak oblik dilihat dari atas: atap (paling terang), dinding depan, dinding samping gelap, bayangan jatuh =====
      const Rw=RNG(11);
      function face(g,e,f,a,b,c,d,w,h,col){ // dinding dengan jendela, koordinat (u,v): v = tinggi dari tanah
        g.save();g.transform(a,b,c,d,e,f);g.fillStyle=col;g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
        if(h>55) for(let u=9;u<w-14;u+=21) for(let v=10;v<h-16;v+=26){
          g.fillStyle=Rw()<0.3?M(C.aksen,col,35):M(col,"black",58);g.fillRect(u,v,12,14);
        }
        g.restore();
      }
      function box(g,x,y,w,d,h,wall,roof=M(wall,"white",55)){
        const dx=h,dy=h*0.35;
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.beginPath();
        [[x,y],[x+w,y],[x+w+dx,y+dy],[x+w+dx,y+d+dy],[x+dx,y+d+dy],[x,y+d]].forEach((p,i)=>g[i?"lineTo":"moveTo"](p[0],p[1]));
        g.fill();
        face(g,x,y,0,1,-SH,-1,d,h,M(wall,"black",70));
        face(g,x,y+d,1,0,-SH,-1,w,h,wall);
        const rx=x-h*SH,ry=y-h;
        g.fillStyle=roof;g.fillRect(rx,ry,w,d);
        if(h>28){ // alat atap: AC, kadang tangki air
          g.fillStyle=M(roof,"black",80);g.fillRect(rx+w*(0.1+0.5*Rw()),ry+d*(0.15+0.4*Rw()),18,12);
          if(Rw()<0.35){
            const tx=rx+w*0.7,ty=ry+d*0.6;
            g.fillStyle=SHD;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(tx+9,ty+5,11,6,0,0,7);g.fill();
            g.fillStyle=M(C.peti,"white",70);g.beginPath();g.arc(tx,ty,10,0,7);g.fill();
          }
        }
      }
      function tree(g,x,y,r){
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x+r*0.7,y+r*0.2,r,r*0.45,0,0,7);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(C.hijau,"black",80);g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y-r*0.8,r,0,7);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(C.hijau,"white",70);g.beginPath();g.arc(x-r*0.25,y-r*1.05,r*0.62,0,7);g.fill();
      }
      function boat(g,x,y,w,col){ // perahu bergerak di laut, tampak samping miring
        g.fillStyle=M(C.aksen,"black",70);g.fillRect(x+6,y-3,w,5);
        g.fillStyle=col;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y-26);g.lineTo(x+w,y-26);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+w+30,y-20,x+w+8,y);g.lineTo(x+8,y);g.quadraticCurveTo(x-6,y-8,x,y-26);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(col,"white",55);g.fillRect(x+4,y-26,w,6);
        box(g,x+w*0.18,y-24,w*0.34,12,24,C.beton);
      }
      function boatTop(g,x,y,col){ // perahu sandar di antara dermaga, haluan ke laut
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x+14,y-40,26,60,0,0,7);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=col;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x-22,y);g.lineTo(x-22,y-78);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y-132,x+22,y-78);g.lineTo(x+22,y);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(col,"white",55);g.fillRect(x-15,y-70,30,64);
        box(g,x-12,y-44,24,26,18,C.beton,M(col,"white",35));
      }

      // ===== 2. Jalan diagonal dan peta, dilukis sekali (kanvas jadi gambar), lalu hanya digeser =====
      const R0=[2450,306],R1=[1060,975];
      const RL=Math.hypot(R1[0]-R0[0],R1[1]-R0[1]),RD=[(R1[0]-R0[0])/RL,(R1[1]-R0[1])/RL],RP=[RD[1],-RD[0]];
      const THETA=Math.atan2(-RD[1],-RD[0]); // sudut sprite searah jalan
      const roadPt=(u,o=0)=>[R0[0]+(R1[0]-R0[0])*u+RP[0]*o,R0[1]+(R1[1]-R0[1])*u+RP[1]*o];
      const roadDist=(x,y)=>Math.abs((x-R0[0])*RD[1]-(y-R0[1])*RD[0]);
      function paintWorld(){
        const c=layer(W,H),g=c.getContext("2d"),R=RNG(7),items=[],add=(y,f)=>items.push({y,f});
        const pale=M(C.kota,"white",42),pier=[240,610,980,1350];
        g.fillStyle=C.kota;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H); // tanah kota biru-abu, lebih terang dari aspal jalan
        const sea=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,330);
        sea.addColorStop(0,M(C.latar,"black",78));sea.addColorStop(1,M(C.aksen,C.latar,45));
        g.fillStyle=sea;g.fillRect(0,0,1700,330);
        g.fillStyle=M("white","transparent",28);

      const RNG=(seed)=>{let s=(seed*2654435761)>>>0||1;return()=>{s=(s+0x6d2b79f5)>>>0;let t=s;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t ^= t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};};
      const W=2900,H=1600,SH=0.35;
      const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),T=(n)=>cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      const M=(a,b,p)=>`color-mix(in oklab, ${a} ${p}%, ${b})`;
      const C={
        latar:T("--latar"),utama:T("--utama"),aksen:T("--aksen"),aspal:T("--aspal"),beton:T("--beton"),
        kota:T("--kota"),kulit:T("--kulit"),peti:T("--peti"),merah:T("--cat-merah"),hijau:T("--cat-hijau"),biru:T("--cat-biru"),kuning:T("--cat-kuning"),
      };
      const CANDY=[C.merah,C.hijau,C.biru,C.kuning,C.utama];
      const WARM=[C.kuning,C.utama,C.merah,C.peti,C.kuning,C.utama];
      const SHD=M(T("--bayang"),"transparent",42);
      const layer=(w,h)=>Object.assign(mk("canvas"),{width:w,height:h});

      // ===== 1. Kotak oblik dilihat dari atas: atap (paling terang), dinding depan, dinding samping gelap, bayangan jatuh =====
      const Rw=RNG(11);
      function face(g,e,f,a,b,c,d,w,h,col){ // dinding dengan jendela, koordinat (u,v): v = tinggi dari tanah
        g.save();g.transform(a,b,c,d,e,f);g.fillStyle=col;g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
        if(h>55) for(let u=9;u<w-14;u+=21) for(let v=10;v<h-16;v+=26){

      function box(g,x,y,w,d,h,wall,roof=M(wall,"white",55)){

            g.fillStyle=M(C.peti,"white",70);g.beginPath();g.arc(tx,ty,10,0,7);g.fill();

      }
      function tree(g,x,y,r){
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x+r*0.7,y+r*0.2,r,r*0.45,0,0,7);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(C.hijau,"black",80);g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y-r*0.8,r,0,7);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(C.hijau,"white",70);g.beginPath();g.arc(x-r*0.25,y-r*1.05,r*0.62,0,7);g.fill();
      }
      function boat(g,x,y,w,col){ // perahu bergerak di laut, tampak samping miring
        g.fillStyle=M(C.aksen,"black",70);g.fillRect(x+6,y-3,w,5);
        g.fillStyle=col;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y-26);g.lineTo(x+w,y-26);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+w+30,y-20,x+w+8,y);g.lineTo(x+8,y);g.quadraticCurveTo(x-6,y-8,x,y-26);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(col,"white",55);g.fillRect(x+4,y-26,w,6);
        box(g,x+w*0.18,y-24,w*0.34,12,24,C.beton);
      }
      function boatTop(g,x,y,col){ // perahu sandar di antara dermaga, haluan ke laut
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x+14,y-40,26,60,0,0,7);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=col;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x-22,y);g.lineTo(x-22,y-78);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y-132,x+22,y-78);g.lineTo(x+22,y);g.fill();
        g.fillStyle=M(col,"white",55);g.fillRect(x-15,y-70,30,64);
        box(g,x-12,y-44,24,26,18,C.beton,M(col,"white",35));
      }

      // ===== 2. Jalan diagonal dan peta, dilukis sekali (kanvas jadi gambar), lalu hanya digeser =====
      const R0=[2450,306],R1=[1060,975];
      const RL=Math.hypot(R1[0]-R0[0],R1[1]-R0[1]),RD=[(R1[0]-R0[0])/RL,(R1[1]-R0[1])/RL],RP=[RD[1],-RD[0]];
      const THETA=Math.atan2(-RD[1],-RD[0]); // sudut sprite searah jalan
      const roadPt=(u,o=0)=>[R0[0]+(R1[0]-R0[0])*u+RP[0]*o,R0[1]+(R1[1]-R0[1])*u+RP[1]*o];
      const roadDist=(x,y)=>Math.abs((x-R0[0])*RD[1]-(y-R0[1])*RD[0]);
      function paintWorld(){
        const c=layer(W,H),g=c.getContext("2d"),R=RNG(7),items=[],add=(y,f)=>items.push({y,f});
        const pale=M(C.kota,"white",42),pier=[240,610,980,1350];
        g.fillStyle=C.kota;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H); // tanah kota biru-abu, lebih terang dari aspal jalan
        const sea=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,330);
        sea.addColorStop(0,M(C.latar,"black",78));sea.addColorStop(1,M(C.aksen,C.latar,45));
        g.fillStyle=sea;g.fillRect(0,0,1700,330);
        g.fillStyle=M("white","transparent",28);
        for(let i=0;i<200;i++) g.fillRect(R()*1700,R()*320,10+R()*26,2);
        g.fillStyle=C.beton;g.fillRect(0,330,1700,90);
        g.fillStyle=M(C.beton,"black",70);g.fillRect(0,330,1700,7);
        for(const x of pier){g.fillStyle=C.beton;g.fillRect(x,150,80,190);g.fillStyle=M(C.beton,"black",70);g.fillRect(x,150,80,6);}
        g.fillStyle=pale;g.fillRect(540,900,1440,700); // alun-alun pasar
        g.fillStyle=M(C.hijau,"black",84);g.fillRect(2000,950,400,320); // taman
        g.lineCap="butt";g.beginPath();g.moveTo(R0[0]*1.2-R1[0]*0.2,R0[1]*1.2-R1[1]*0.2);g.lineTo(R1[0],R1[1]);
        g.strokeStyle=C.beton;g.lineWidth=150;g.stroke();
        g.strokeStyle=C.aspal;g.lineWidth=112;g.stroke();
        g.strokeStyle=M("white","transparent",60);g.lineWidth=3;g.setLineDash([30,24]);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);
        for(const [bx,i] of [[465,0],[835,1],[1205,2]]) for(const o of [-55,55]){

        add(580,()=>box(g,300,470,800,110,60,M(C.utama,"white",45),C.utama)); // balai lelang
        add(590,()=>box(g,1200,450,260,130,100,M(C.aksen,"white",55)));
        for(let x=100;x<2900;x+=165) for(let y=420;y<1560;y+=150){ // kota: balok setinggi 1 sampai 4 lantai
          const px=x+R()*40,py=y+R()*30,w=90+R()*50,d=70+R()*45,h=24+R()*76;

          const plaza=px>500&&px<2000&&py>860,park=px>1950&&py>930&&py<1290;

      }

      // ===== 3. Tiga tingkat blur dari satu lukisan =====
      const cams=[0,1,2].map((i)=>$("cam"+i));
      const acts=[];
      function build(){
        const base=paintWorld(),ttl=$("ttl");
        [[1,0,0],[0.5,3,6],[0.5,8,16]].forEach(([s,b,tb],i)=>{
          const c=layer(W*s,H*s),x=c.getContext("2d"),pad=b*2;
          if(b) x.filter=`blur(${b}px)`;

          const im=mk("img"),t=ttl.cloneNode(true),ac=layer(W/2,H/2);
          Object.assign(im,{src:c["toDataURL"]("image/jpeg",0.92)});
          Object.assign(im.style,{width:W+"px",height:H+"px"});
          Object.assign(ac.style,{width:W+"px",height:H+"px"});
          t.removeAttribute("id");
          if(tb) t.style.filter=`blur(${tb}px)`;
          cams[i].prepend(ac);cams[i].prepend(t);cams[i].prepend(im);

      }
      build();

      // ===== 4. Pelaku: dihitung dari waktu dunia, digambar ulang hanya saat waktu dunia melompat =====
      const wrapU=(v)=>((v+0.15)%1.35+1.35)%1.35-0.15; // konvoi berputar di sepanjang jalan
      const tri=(u)=>1-abs(2*(((u%1)+1)%1)-1);
      const R=RNG(23);
      const MUTE=[C.merah,C.hijau,C.biru,C.kuning].map((c)=>M(c,C.beton,55));
      const BOATS=[0,1,2,3].map((i)=>({x0:i*800,v:3+i*0.6,y:60+i*24,w:90+i*8,c:CANDY[i]}));
      const WALK=Array.from({length:40},(_,i)=>({
        i,x:R()*1250,ph:R(),sp:0.005+R()*0.006,c:CANDY[floor(R()*5)],load:R()<0.5,lane:[985,1085,1185,1300,1390][i%5],
      }));
      function truck(g,x,y,dir,body,cargo,len,rot=0){
        g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(rot);g.scale(dir*1.5,1.5);
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.fillRect(-len+6,-8,len+18,12);
        g.fillStyle=cargo;g.fillRect(-len,-30,len-20,26);
        g.fillStyle=M(cargo,"white",55);g.fillRect(-len,-36,len-20,6);
        g.fillStyle=body;g.fillRect(-18,-26,20,22);g.fillRect(-14,-31,16,5);
        g.fillStyle=M(body,"black",30);g.fillRect(-2,-23,4,9);

        g.restore();
      }
      function person(g,x,y,col,load){
        g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.scale(1.5,1.5);
        g.fillStyle=SHD;g.fillRect(-2,-2,9,4);
        g.fillStyle=col;g.fillRect(-3,-13,6,12);
        g.fillStyle=C.kulit;g.beginPath();g.arc(0,-16,3.2,0,7);g.fill();
        if(load){g.fillStyle=C.peti;g.fillRect(-6,-24,12,7);}
        g.restore();
      }
      function hero(Wq){ // truk es: ikut konvoi lalu menepi ke sisi alun-alun

      function paint(Wq){ // satu gambar tajam, lalu disalin dengan blur sekali per tingkat

        for(const b of BOATS){
          const x=((b.x0+b.v*Wq)%1900+1900)%1900-200; // perahu hanya di laut (x < 1700)
          g.fillStyle=M("white","transparent",55);g.fillRect(x-60,b.y-2,60,2);

        const base=0.15+0.8*(Wq-240)/120;

        const [hx,hy,ha]=hero(Wq);
        truck(g,hx,hy,-1,M(C.utama,"black",72),C.utama,80,ha);
        for(const p of WALK){ // pelabuhan: jalan di dermaga; alun-alun: menyusuri lorong
          if(p.i<10) person(g,[280,650,1020,1390][p.i%4]+p.x/30,200+tri(Wq*p.sp+p.ph)*210,p.c,p.load);

        }
        for(const a of acts){
          a.g.clearRect(0,0,W,H);a.g.filter=a.blur?`blur(${a.blur}px)`:"none";
          a.g.drawImage(scratch,0,0);
        }
      }
      const scratch=layer(W/2,H/2);

      // ===== 5. Waktu dunia: dipercepat ×60, ×30, ×120, lalu jatuh ke ×1. Kamera tetap mulus, dunia melompat. =====
      const SP=(t)=>(t<4?60:t<8?30:t<12?120:t<12.9?lerp(120,1,ss((t-12)/0.9)):1);
      const WT=[0];
      function table(){for(let i=1;i<=1800;i++) WT.push(WT[i-1]+SP((i-0.5)/120)/120);}

      const worldAt=(t)=>{const f=clamp(t,0,15)*120,i=Math.min(floor(f),1799);return lerp(WT[i],WT[i+1],f-i);};
      const hms=(s)=>{s=20400+floor(s);const p=(n)=>String(n).padStart(2,"0");return `${p(floor(s/3600))}:${p(floor(s/60)%60)}:${p(s%60)}`;};
      const HP=roadPt(0.95,92),P15=roadPt(0.15,22);
      function camAt(t){ // empat bingkai berbeda: dermaga, jalan diagonal, alun-alun, serah terima

        if(Wq!==lastW){lastW=Wq;paint(Wq);$("clk").textContent=hms(Wq);}
        const label=sp>1.5?`×${Math.round(sp)} TIME-LAPSE`:"×1 WAKTU NYATA";
        if(label!==lastSpd){lastSpd=label;$("spd").textContent=label;}
      }

      // ===== 6. Papan teks, hitungan, dan serah terima peti (waktu nyata, mulus) =====
      const sign=(id,a,b)=>{
        tl.fromTo(id,{autoAlpha:0,y:14},{autoAlpha:1,y:0,duration:0.35,ease:"power2.out"},a);
        if(b) tl.to(id,{autoAlpha:0,y:-8,duration:0.25,ease:"power1.in"},b);
      };
      sign("#s1",0.4,3.7);sign("#s2",4.3,7.7);sign("#s3",8.3,11.8);sign("#s4",12.4);
      const n={v:0};
      tl.to(n,{v:312,duration:2.9,ease:"steps(26)",onUpdate:()=>{$("n").textContent=Math.round(n.v);}},8.4);
      // Serah terima: A mengangkat peti dari bak, melempar ringan ke B yang menangkap.
      const [hx,hy]=HP;
      gsap.set("#wa",{x:hx+138,y:hy+2,xPercent:-50,yPercent:-100});gsap.set("#wb",{x:hx+215,y:hy-4,xPercent:-50,yPercent:-100});
      gsap.set("#cr",{x:hx+118,y:hy-38,xPercent:-50,yPercent:-100});
      tl.set("#hero",{visibility:"visible"},12);
      tl.to("#wa",{rotation:9,duration:0.25,ease:"power2.out"},12.15).to("#wa",{rotation:0,duration:0.35,ease:"power2.inOut"},12.4);
      tl.to("#cr",{x:hx+212,duration:0.7,ease:"power1.inOut"},12.25).to("#cr",{y:hy-70,duration:0.33,ease:"power2.out"},12.25).to("#cr",{y:hy-42,duration:0.37,ease:"power2.in"},12.58);
      tl.to("#wb",{scaleY:0.88,duration:0.14,ease:"power2.out"},12.9).to("#wb",{scaleY:1,duration:0.3,ease:"back.out(2)"},13.04);

      tl.to(jam,{t:15,duration:15,ease:"none",onUpdate:()=>render(jam.t)},0);

    </script>
